title: Software Engineer (Golang)
description:
**Description**
 Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.
   

  

 With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, space consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, flight test services, satellite propulsion systems, and much more.
   

  

 SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.
   

  

 Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help Earth benefit from space?
   

  

 If you answer yes to this question, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact as Software Engineer in our team. We are looking for a dedicated person who shares our core values of Customer passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage.
   

  

 The Software unit within SSC Connect is entrusted to develop and maintain critical systems required to connect our customers with their satellites. As our Software Engineer, you’ll develop and maintain the critical systems that keep our customers connected with their satellites every day.
   

  

**Requirements**
 We think that you care - about your systems, your colleagues, and your users. That you have a creative and analytical mindset. You take responsibility, drive your own initiatives, and can learn and process technical details quickly. We also think that you appreciate both working autonomously and together with other people.
   

  

 We believe you have a BSc or similar degree in Computer Science or Engineering and several years of experience in software development.
   

  

 To succeed in this role, you should have:
   

  

* Proven experience in Go development
* Proven experience with git
* Proven experience with unit testing and system test scripting
* Experience developing and deploying applications on cloud platforms
* Solid knowledge of Linux environments
* Excellent communication skills in English.


**We Also Value If You Have Experience With**
* Experience building scalable and reliable infrastructure on cloud platforms
* Knowledge of Kubernetes
* Experience with message bus technologies (RabbitMq, NATS, Kafka)
* API development experience (RESTful / JSON / XML)
* Familiarity with DevOps and CI/CD methodologies
* Experience with databases (SQL/NoSQL)
* Interest or experience within the space industry.


 You must hold EU citizenship and be able to travel occasionally.
   

  

 This role is also critical for our operational services and may include participation in an on-call rotation (up to one week per month).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 We are seeking an experienced software engineer to:
   

  

* Build and maintain high-quality software for mission-critical applications.
* Advance automation in testing, deployment, and delivery.
* Enhance observability through monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions.
* Contribute to continuous improvement within our agile teams.
* Support live missions and ensure system reliability in production.


**Benefits**
**We offer you**
* A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
* An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
* An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.


**Additional benefits**
* In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.
* Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
* Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
* Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
* Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
* Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.


**LOCATION** 

 This is a full-time, permanent position based at our office in either Solna or Kiruna.
   

  

**FURTHER INFORMATION**
 For questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact:
   

  

 Jenny Rudenstål, Global Software Engineering Manager: jenny.rudenstal@sscspace.com.
   

  

 For questions regarding employment terms or union-related matters, you are welcome to contact our union representatives:
   

  

 Sveriges Ingenjörer: SverigesIngenjorer-AF@sscspace.com
   

  

 Unionen: unionen@sscspace.com
   

  

  

  

**NEXT STEP** 

 If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.
   

  

 You can submit your application up until 2026-09-27, which is the latest possible date for consideration.
   

  

 Please note, however, that the position may be filled before this date, and the advertisement may therefore close earlier. This allows us to manage the process efficiently and give each application the attention it deserves.
   

  

 When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.
   

  

 This position requires approved pre-employment screening. These controls are based on the role that you will fulfill within the company. Additional requirements regarding citizenship may apply.
   

  

**WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE**
 SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.
   

  

 With local presence on all continents and about 700 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.
   

  

 We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

title: Backend Software Engineer (Go) - UniFi Connect

title: Senior Software Engineer - On Device Machine Learning
description:
**Description & Requirements**
 Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

 Senior Software Engineer
   

  

 Frostbite is EA's proprietary game engine. Its versatile tools and modern technology power creation on some of the world's most iconic games, including titles from EA SPORTS and Battlefield. By joining Frostbite, you'll be at the forefront of game engine development, collaborating with top-tier developers to push the boundaries of interactive realism and immersive gameplay.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with expertise in software optimization for gaming consoles and CPU/GPU architectures to join our Machine Learning team. You'll report to a Leader of Engine Development and collaborate with both game and central technology engineers and researchers to bring ML models into the hands of our players by deploying them directly into EA's games.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* You will design end-to-end solutions for running machine learning models on a variety of devices.
* You will partner with ML experts across EA to help adopt and scale new models and architectures optimised for on-device performance.
* Integrate ML solutions into our proprietary tools and game runtime environments on consoles, PCs, and mobile devices.


**Qualifications**
* 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with C++, including expertise in multithreading and low-level/near-hardware optimizations.
* Knowledge of GPU programming.
* Proficient in debugging, profiling, and optimising real-time software.
* Understand and practice of software engineering fundamentals, such as version control, code reviews, documentation, automated testing, coding standards, CI/CD, issue tracking, and Agile.
* BSc or MSc degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent professional experience.
* Experience collaborating and sharing updates with developers and partners, including remote and asynchronous teams across different time zones.


**About Electronic Arts**
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
   

  

 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
   

  

 Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

title: Engineer – AI och Produktutveckling
description:
Beskrivning av tjänsten
   

  

 Vill du vara med och bygga nästa generations mjukvarulösningar med AI som en central komponent?
   

  

 Hos oss får du utveckla moderna mjukvaruprodukter där AI används som en naturlig del av både utvecklingsprocessen och de lösningar vi bygger. Vi utforskar kontinuerligt nya möjligheter inom AI – från intelligenta arbetsflöden och automatisering till AI-agenter och andra tillämpningar.
   

  

 Du blir en del av en etablerad produktorganisation där du får arbeta hands-on med modern mjukvaruutveckling, påverka tekniska vägval och bidra till hur vi utvecklar våra produkter och arbetssätt framåt. Här får du möjlighet att kombinera din erfarenhet som utvecklare med ett växande område inom AI och omsätta idéer till lösningar som används i verkligheten.
   

  

 Du behöver inte redan vara specialist inom AI. Vi söker framför allt dig som har en bra grund inom mjukvaruutveckling, är nyfiken på möjligheterna med AI och vill utvecklas vidare inom området.
   

  

 Det här är inte en roll med fokus på förvaltning. Du får vara med och bygga nytt, testa idéer och bidra till hur vi använder AI och ny teknik i vår produktutveckling. Du arbetar nära verksamhet, kunder och andra specialistroller och får goda möjligheter att påverka både lösningar och arbetssätt.
   

  

**Vad vi erbjuder:**
 ✅Möjlighet att kombinera din erfarenhet inom mjukvaruutveckling med AI och ny teknik
   

  

 ✅Vara med och påverka produkten, tekniska vägval och hur vi arbetar med AI
   

  

 ✅Arbeta med moderna AI-verktyg och AI-drivna lösningar som en del av utvecklingsarbetet
   

  

 ✅Möjlighet att arbeta med hela utvecklingskedjan – från idé och design till produktion
   

  

 ✅ Nära samarbete med verksamhet och kunder där du ser resultatet av det du bygger
   

  

**Placeringsort: Stockholm, Malmö eller Karlstad**
 Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter
   

  

 Som Senior Engineer blir du en viktig del av vår produktutveckling. Du arbetar tillsammans med verksamhet, kunder och andra specialistroller för att förstå behov och omsätta dem till användbara tekniska lösningar.
   

  

 Vi arbetar idag brett med produktivitetsverktyg och AI-relaterade initiativ i flera delar av organisationen. Nu samlar vi dessa satsningar i ett gemensamt team för att accelerera utvecklingen av både interna verktyg, arbetssät och nya funktioner som skapar värde för våra kunder.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att:
   

  

* Utveckla moderna mjukvaruprodukter där AI är en viktig del av lösningen
* Arbeta med integration av AI-tjänster, API, verktyg och affärsprocesser
* Utforska nya möjligheter inom AI, testa idéer och omsätta dem till praktiska lösningar för kunder och användare
* Bidra till tekniska vägval, systemdesign och utvecklingen av våra arbetssätt
* Arbeta med moderna utvecklingsmetoder, automatiserad testning och CI/CD
* Dela med dig av din erfarenhet och bidra till kunskapsdelning och teknisk utveckling i teamet


 Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling och ett stort intresse för hur AI kan användas för att utveckla bättre produkter och arbetssätt. Du behöver inte redan vara specialist inom AI – viktigare är att du har en stabil utvecklarbakgrund, är nyfiken på tekniken och vill fortsätta utvecklas inom området.
   

  

 För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av modern mjukvaruutveckling, exempelvis i Python, TypeScript, .NET eller liknande teknologier
* Förståelse för systemdesign och hur olika delar i en modern mjukvarulösning hänger ihop
* Erfarenhet av moderna utvecklingsmetoder, CI/CD och automatiserade utvecklingsflöden
* Intresse för AI och hur tekniken kan användas i mjukvaruutveckling och produkter


 Du har gärna börjat använda AI-baserade verktyg som exempelvis Copilot, Cursor, Gemini, Codex eller motsvarande i ditt utvecklingsarbete. Det viktigaste är dock inte vilka verktyg du redan behärskar, utan att du är nyfiken och vill utforska hur AI kan bidra till bättre lösningar och arbetssätt.
   

  

 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av ett eller flera av följande områden:
   

  

* Utveckling av AI-lösningar eller AI-drivna funktioner
* Lösningsarkitektur och skalbara system
* DevOps, automatisering och säker utveckling
* Agent frameworks såsom LangChain, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel eller AutoGen
* RAG, vector databases, AI-evaluering eller prompt engineering
* Azure eller andra molnplattformar
* Docker, Kubernetes eller andra containerbaserade miljöer
* Nutanix eller liknande infrastrukturplattformar


 Som person är du nyfiken och gillar att utforska nya tekniska möjligheter. Du tar ansvar för ditt arbete, samarbetar gärna med andra och vill vara med och utveckla både produkterna och hur vi arbetar med ny teknik.
   

  

 Som en del av den här rekryteringsprocessen genomför vi bakgrundskontroller på slutkandidaten. Kontrollen omfattar en kreditupplysning via UC samt ett registerutdrag, vilket inkluderar uppgifter från belastningsregistret och domstolar.
   

  

 Syftet är att säkerställa efterlevnad av omvärldens krav, våra kunders ökade fokus på säkerhet samt CGI globala standard.
   

  

 Om det finns ytterligare information som du vill att vi ska känna till i samband med rekryteringen är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef.
   

  

 Har du frågor om rollen? Hör gärna av dig till Pär Jönsson, Director Consulting Delivery, via e-post par.jonsson@cgi.com.
   

  

**Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.**
 Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.

title: Senior Usability Engineer
description:
**About The Company**
 SHL Medical is a world-leading provider in the design, development, and manufacturing of advanced self-injection devices. With a global team of 6,000 employees, we partner with leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies to deliver innovative autoinjectors, pen injectors, and other drug delivery systems that ensure effective treatment for patients. Headquartered in Switzerland since 2018, with key operations in Sweden, Taiwan, and the US, we are united by a commitment to innovation, impact, and growth. Together, we empower our people to develop solutions that make a meaningful difference in the lives of millions of patients while fostering a supportive, inclusive, and dynamic workplace for our colleagues.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 A Senior Usability Engineer is responsible for providing usability expertise to projects and programs supporting the department’s user centered design approach. Usability engineering involves the testing of designs at various stages of the development process, with users or with usability experts. Through user studies and expert know-how, the Senior Usability Engineer applies knowledge of design, materials and regulations to provide input to various departments on product usability.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Develop and operate within standard operating procedures (SOPs) aligned with risk management and design control frameworks, ensuring compliance with ISO 14971, IEC 62366, and FDA guidance.
* Support in developing work instructions and templates to for usability engineering and user centered design activities under the established SOPs.
* Plan and execute design-related research programs, including proposing scientifically supported design specifications for medical devices and providing justifications for existing specifications.
* Generating research findings in relevant contexts for publications.
* Develop and manage Usability Engineering Files, including Use Specification, Usability Engineering Plan, User Interface Evaluation Plan, Formative and Summative Evaluation Protocols/Reports, and Usability Engineering Report.
* Design Usability Engineering strategies for regulatory submissions, including implementing the complete process or pursuing a waiver for validation testing.
* Define usability-related design inputs such as risk control measures (RCMs) or enhancements for user experience (non-risk-related design inputs).
* Plan and conduct formative evaluations (field work) to gather user feedback and support iterative design.
* Plan and conduct user capacity testing (field work), gather user feedback on tasks and on designs and support the iterative user-centered design.
* Create quick reference guides for usability evaluation purposes.
* Other tasks related to the position.


**Minimum Requirements**
* 5+ years of professional experience as a Human Factors Engineer / Usability Engineer in the medical devices space.
* Strong knowledge of work principles, methodologies as well as related activities within Usability Engineering/Human Factors, and User Interaction and Experience.
* Experience with QMS systems as well as standards and regulations related to the medical device field.
* Experience in verification and validation of medical devices.
* Degree in Human Factors Engineering, Usability Engineering, or equivalent.
* Fluent in English, speech and writing.


**Preferred Requirements**
* Experience in combination products like autoinjectors, pen injectors, electric-mechanical autoinjectors, infusion systems, safety syringes/cartridges, etc
* Fluent in Swedish, speech and writing


**We Offer**
* A company culture Focusing on our Customers, Operating with Ethics and Integrity, Driving Simplicity, Learning, Improving & Delivering Together.
* Challenging assignments in a fast growing and innovative industry.
* Various opportunities for personal and professional development within a global organization.
* Flexible hours and hybrid working policy.
* A modern working environment in Nacka Strand, Stockholm, with multicultural and motivated teams.


 Interested in joining SHL Medical and in supporting us with your expertise and personality? Then we look forward to receiving your application including your CV, motivation letter, and all other relevant documents.
   

  

 For more information on SHL Medical, please visit:
 **shl-medical.com**

title: Digital Product Owner - NOCCO I Barebells I Vitamin Well
description:
***Vitamin Well Group***
*develops premium functional drinks, snacks and protein products designed for modern, everyday life and on-the-go consumption. Our portfolio includes Barebells, NOCCO and Vitamin Well. With over 750 employees and revenue of more than SEK 10 billion, we are present in over 50 markets, with our headquarters in Stockholm and local teams and partners around the world. Our growth is driven by a focus on building strong brands, creating products with uncompromising taste and clear functionality, and consistently raising the bar across our categories.*
 We are building a team to lead the next phase of Vitamin Well Group’s digital business. We work across e-commerce, internal tools and data, with AI integrated into how we build products, improve workflows and create better user experiences.
   

  

 Whether it is making the shopping experience on our sites genuinely personal, building agentic analytics that make data more accessible and actionable across the business, or replacing manual internal workflows with agents that just get the job done, our focus is on building solutions that solve real problems and create long-term value.
   

  

 We combine product and engineering capabilities with a pragmatic, ship-focused approach, and we set the direction for how the digital business operates going forward.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a
 **Digital Product Owner** 
 to take end-to-end ownership of the digital experience across our direct-to-consumer (DTC) sites. Working alongside another Digital Product Owner in the team, you will collaborate closely on priorities and direction while taking clear ownership of the DTC experience.
   

  

 You set the direction for what we build, why it matters, and in what order, and turn that direction into products and experiences that create measurable customer and business value.
   

  

 You lead product development hand in hand with engineering and design, moving from discovery to delivery in tight loops rather than big-bang releases. You work across both our in-house team and our external agency, keeping everyone aligned on outcomes and driving progress without compromising on quality.
   

  

 Because both the team and the platform are new, you will have real influence over what we build, how we build it and what the DTC experience looks like for years ahead.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Own the digital experience and product roadmap across our DTC e-commerce sites, end to end
* Run iterative, outcome-driven product development together with engineering and design
* Translate business goals and customer insights into a clear, prioritized backlog that guides delivery
* Coordinate delivery across both the in-house team and our external agency, keeping quality high and momentum steady
* Define success metrics and use data and experimentation to guide priorities and product decisions
* Use AI to improve discovery, personalization and customer experiences, identifying where it can create meaningful value across the DTC journey


 Who are you
   

  

 You are a pragmatic problem solver who enjoys building and shipping products that make an impact. You have worked in scale-ups or smaller companies where the platform was new, the team was small, and you had to figure things out as you went.
   

  

 You understand where AI creates real value and how to apply it in practical ways across products, workflows and user experiences. You are comfortable using AI tools as a natural part of how you work, think and move quickly.
   

  

 You combine strong product judgment with a strong sense of ownership. You take initiative, move things forward independently, and you are just as comfortable in a backlog refinement with engineers as you are steering an agency or aligning stakeholders across the business.
   

  

 What you will bring
   

  

* 5+ years of experience in product ownership or product management, ideally for DTC e-commerce or digital consumer products
* A track record of leading iterative product development together with engineering and design, from discovery through to launch
* Hands-on experience working with both in-house teams and external agencies, and getting the best out of each
* Strong understanding of e-commerce and the modern web, with hands-on Shopify experience and a solid understanding of how technical and design choices shape the customer experience
* A data-informed approach, comfortable with metrics, KPIs, web analytics and experimentation (A/B testing) to drive decisions
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to turn ambiguity into a clear plan


 How to apply
   

  

*Application deadline: 16th October 2026*
 We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position before the application deadline. We appreciate LinkedIn, but to get a full picture of your experience, we ask you to also include a CV.
   

  

**Life at Vitamin Well Group**
 At Vitamin Well Group, we believe that a great workplace fuels great products. With over 750 employees worldwide, our people play an important role in how we build brands, develop products and grow the business. Our values – innovation, courage, drive and responsibility – shape how we work together and how we do business.
   

  

 Across functions and markets, our teams are hands-on in building our brands, developing our products and making them available to consumers around the world. We embrace an office-first principle because we believe our best ideas emerge when people come together, share ideas, build relationships and take ownership.
   

  

 Promoting active lifestyles is part of our culture. Employees can take part in run clubs, group workouts, races and sporting events that suit different interests and fitness levels. As we continue to grow, we aim to make a positive impact by reducing our environmental footprint, promoting active and healthy lifestyles, and acting responsibly across our value chain.
   

  

*As part of the recruitment process, we may ask you to conduct a personality test as well as a test that measures logical ability. The purpose of the tests is to evaluate candidates as objective as possible and identify the best possible match for the role. The tests are based on solid research and are taken through our partner Alva Labs.*

 As Senior AI Cloud Architect, you own the cloud architecture for our AI platform and shared services. You will define reference architectures, make key technology choices (Microsoft-first, but open), and ensure security, reliability, and automation as we scale.

* Design and evolve the target architecture for a public-cloud-first AI platform (Azure preferred).
* Exploration of alternative deployment strategies for high-security customers
* Build secure, compliant foundations: landing zones, identity, networking, encryption, secrets, logging, and policy-as-code.
* Architect for scale and automation: infrastructure as code, CI/CD, GitOps, self-service environments, and operational runbooks.
* Own platform reliability: observability, SLOs, incident patterns, performance, and cost optimization (FinOps).
* Define patterns for AI product integration: APIs, event-driven processing, data pipelines, and multi-tenant considerations.
* Partner with AI engineers/data scientists on MLOps and LLMOps: model delivery pipelines, feature stores, evaluation, and monitoring.
* Drive security and Trustworthy AI practices together with security, privacy, and product teams (GDPR and data residency aware).
* Support solutioning and pre-sales when needed, and mentor architects/engineers across product teams.


**What You Bring**
* Senior – 8-10+ years of relevant experience, including service or solution architecture in complex product environments. More junior profiles will be considered in case of relevant experience – not the time but the type of experience and responsibility is important to us.
* Strong public cloud architecture skills (Azure: AKS/Container Apps, Functions, App Service, API Management, Event Hubs/Service Bus, Storage, SQL/Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Entra ID).
* Experience with multiple deployment scenarios and high security requirements is a plus
* Hands-on experience with automation: Terraform and/or Bicep, CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), and modern deployment practices.
* Proven security architecture skills: threat modeling, zero trust, network segmentation, secrets management, vulnerability management, and audit readiness.
* Experience building or operating AI/ML platforms: Azure ML/MLflow, model serving, data pipelines, and LLM integration patterns.
* Ability to translate business needs into pragmatic architectures and communicate clearly with both engineers and stakeholders.


**Nice to have**
* Experience with GenAI platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI) and guardrails: content filters, prompt injection defense, red teaming, and evaluation.
* Knowledge of data engineering components: Databricks/Spark, Delta Lake, data streaming, and search/vector databases.
* Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Security Engineer, or similar.


**Impact you will have**
* Own the reference architecture for our cloud-first AI platform supporting AI capabilities for public organizations in the Nordics.
* Raise the security and compliance baseline with zero-trust patterns, policy-as-code, and audit-ready controls.
* Increase delivery speed and consistency through automation: self-service environments.
* Improve reliability and cost efficiency with SLO-driven operations, observability, and FinOps practices.


**Tech we use**
 Azure-first and automation-driven: containers/Kubernetes, serverless, messaging, IaC (Terraform/Bicep), CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), observability, and cloud security tooling. We are open to AWS/GCP experience.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like In 6 Months**
* A clear platform roadmap indicating the next steps for our data and ai platform as baseline for our product teams, supporting our vision of AI-first and agentic-first software offerings in the public sector domain.
* Review and implementation of defined improvements of automation framework and pipelines in place for core platform services.
* Operational excellence established: dashboards, SLOs, alerting, and incident playbooks used in day-to-day operations.
* Security and Trustworthy AI governance embedded: threat models, risk assessments, and guardrail patterns for GenAI use cases.


**Why join us**
* Build technology that improves citizen services - with real-world scale and meaningful impact.
* A highly skilled, collaborative environment with room to influence architecture decisions end-to-end.
* Modern cloud-first stack, strong focus on security and responsible AI, and freedom to explore new approaches (including agentic AI).
* Professional growth, international collaboration, and a culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership.


**Practicalities**
 Location and work setup: flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen or Espoo). Fluent English required; Nordic language skills are a plus.
   

  

**Are you our new colleague?**
 We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Geir Are Bjørnsrud (geirare.bjornsrud@tietoevry.com)
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: Data Engineer

 Hos oss får du chansen att jobba med några av Sveriges mest spännande kunder och projekt. Vad innebär det? Jo, att du får:
   

  

* Gräva i och tillgängliggöra data som inte bara hjälper våra kunder – utan kanske till och med gör världen lite bättre.
* Göra företag mer datadrivna och smartare genom att guida dem i rätt riktning.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Vill du ta plats i hjärtat av moderna Linuxplattformar och samtidigt se dina lösningar göra skillnad i verkliga miljöer? På HiQ i Stockholm får du en roll där du både fördjupar dig i tekniken och är med och driver utvecklingen framåt tillsammans med andra som brinner för smarta lösningar.
   

  

**Om rollen:**
 Som Platform Engineer arbetar du i skärningspunkten mellan Linux, plattform och mjukvaruutveckling. Du får en central roll i utvecklingen av våra Linuxbaserade plattformar och testmiljöer, från lokala utvecklingsmiljöer till hårdvara som används i verklig drift. I vardagen kombinerar du praktisk problemlösning med långsiktigt arbete med struktur, prestanda och stabilitet. Du rör dig mellan flera teknikområden, som Linux, automation, test, infrastruktur och mjukvaruutveckling, och blir en nyckelperson för att få helheten att fungera. Rollen passar dig som vill arbeta nära tekniken, ta ansvar och bygga hållbara lösningar över tid.
   

  

**Du kommer att:**
* Konfigurera, underhålla och vidareutveckla Linuxbaserade plattformar, inklusive tjänster, nätverk och resurser
* Skriva och underhålla skript i till exempel Bash och Python för att automatisera miljöuppsättning, deployment, logginsamling och verifieringsflöden
* Arbeta med mjukvaruutveckling i större modulära system, främst i Java, och bidra till robusta lösningar som fungerar både i test och i drift
* Integrera och vidareutveckla testautomation så att tester kan köras konsekvent, reproducerbart och effektivt i olika miljöer
* Identifiera och driva förbättringar inom prestanda, stabilitet, kvalitet och struktur i plattformen och dess omgivande miljöer


**Vi tror att du har:**
* Flera års erfarenhet av Linux i utvecklings eller testmiljö, gärna Debian eller Ubuntu
* Erfarenhet av att konfigurera Linuxservrar samt arbeta med infrastrukturautomation och konfigurationshantering, till exempel med Ansible eller Puppet
* God vana av skriptning och objektorienterad utveckling, gärna i språk som Python och Java
* Erfarenhet av containerteknik och orkestrering, till exempel Docker och Kubernetes
* God erfarenhet av Git eller annat modernt versionshanteringssystem
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift
* Gärna också erfarenhet av nätverksprestanda och trafikanalys, hårdvarunära verifiering eller övervakning och loggning i Linuxmiljöer


**Varför HiQ?**
 Hos oss kliver du in i ett sammanhang där det är naturligt att dela kunskap, hjälpa varandra i komplexa felsökningslägen och tillsammans hitta lösningar som fungerar både på utvecklarens dator och ute i verklig driftmiljö. Du får utrymme att fördjupa dig inom Linux, automation och test, samtidigt som du uppmuntras att utforska nya tekniker och arbetssätt som kan lyfta både plattformen och teamet.
   

  

 Du blir en del av ett gäng som uppskattar nyfikenhet, initiativförmåga och teknikglädje, där vi gärna testar nya idéer i liten skala och skalar upp det som fungerar. Här får du både ansvar och stöd, tydliga möjligheter att växa och chansen att arbeta nära tekniken i uppdrag som spelar roll på riktigt.
   

  

 Sedan 1995 har HiQ varit konsultbolaget som förenklar världen för både kunder och slutanvändare med hjälp av teknik, design och kommunikation. Vi har alltid haft två tydliga fokus: att ha roligt på jobbet och att leverera lösningar som överträffar förväntningarna – det är det som driver oss framåt. Som HiQare är vi stolta över en kultur som präglas av resultat, ansvar, enkelhet och glädje. Vi tror på att arbeta tillsammans för att nå gemensamma mål och vi lägger stor vikt vid att hjälpa varandra att växa och utvecklas. Hos oss får du inte bara möjlighet att bygga din egen kompetens, utan också chansen att lära, leda och inspirera dina kollegor.

title: DevOps ingenjör
description:

**May the Source be with you!**

 The Resilience Officer is a critical role within the second line of defense of Bambora, part of Worldline. If you're someone who sees the bigger picture, has a liking for problem-solving, and has a keen interest in resilience and business continuity management , we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

  

  

 Reporting directly to the Entity’s Head of Risk and Compliance Officer, and also supporting your local entity’s management team and senior specialists, you'll play an integral role in driving the effective operation of our operating environment. You will be supported by the global entity resilience officer network and will also participate in global resilience initiatives to ensure that business continuity management industry best practices are rolled-out across Worldline.
   

  

 You will be part of a team with many experienced and dedicated resilience officers spread across the world that would love for you to work with them! title: Product and Technical Communications
description:
**TL;DR** 
 - Lovable ships fast. When millions of people build real businesses on your platform, both the product story and the trust story have to be airtight. You’ll own product and technical communications that makes sure this is the case: launches, trust and incident response, and the narrative that connects what we build to why it matters.
   

  

 Why Lovable?
   

  

 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

**Own trust, security, and incident communications.** 
 People build real businesses on Lovable, and their confidence in the platform is existential to ours. You’ll own Lovable’s trust narrative in earned and new media, proactively telling the story of how we think about security, privacy, reliability, and platform safety. And when something doesn’t go as planned, you’ll be the comms lead in the room, working alongside the Head of Communications to manage the external response with a cross-functional team.
   

  

**Lead product launch communications.** 
 When Lovable ships something new, you own the earned media strategy around it, including knowing the right Substacks, podcasts, and new media channels beyond traditional outlets. You’ll work closely with product marketing to shape positioning, develop press materials, pitch the story, and make sure launches land. You’ll build a repeatable launch engine that moves as fast as the product team does.
   

  

**Turn journalists and creators into builders.** 
 Some of the most powerful product coverage comes from people who’ve experienced Lovable firsthand. You’ll develop relationships with earned media and creators by getting the product into their hands, helping journalists, technical writers, and influencers build something real on Lovable so they can tell the product story from their own experience.
   

  

**Be the comms partner to our CTO and product leadership.** 
 You’ll develop spokesperson platforms for our CTO, CISO, and senior product and engineering leaders. In partnership with product marketing, you’ll prep them for media, conferences, and podcasts. You’ll help them become recognized voices defining a new product category.
   

  

**Own product-level partner integration comms.** 
 When Lovable launches a technical integration or platform capability that changes what builders can do, you own the comms. You’ll coordinate with product marketing and partnerships to shape the narrative and get it in front of the right audiences.
   

  

**Build analyst and technical influencer relationships.** 
 You’ll build relationships with the analysts, tech media, and voices that shape opinion among technical audiences. You’ll make sure Lovable shows up in the right conversations and earns positioning in the right reports.
   

  

**Ensure product news travels beyond traditional media.** 
 Product stories in 2026 don’t just live in TechCrunch. You’ll make sure product news reaches the Substacks, podcasts, technical creators, and communities where your audiences are.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

**You’re technically fluent and genuinely curious about the product.** 
 You don’t need to be an engineer, but you need to understand how software products work, architecturally, not just conceptually. When an engineer explains a design decision, you understand why it matters and can translate it into something a reporter or analyst would care about.
   

  

**You’ve run product comms at a fast-moving technology company.** 
 You’ve lived through the chaos of a product team that ships faster than comms can keep up, and you’ve built systems to stay ahead. You know how to run a launch process that’s tight but not slow, and you know when to push for a bigger moment versus when to just get the word out.
   

  

**You have real trust and incident comms experience.** 
 You’ve worked on or alongside security, privacy, or trust and safety teams. You know the difference between proactive trust storytelling and reactive crisis management, and you’ve done both. You’ve been in the room during a product incident and know how to craft external communications that are honest, precise, and fast.
   

  

**You have strong media relationships in the tech and AI ecosystem.** 
 You know the reporters, podcasters, and analysts who cover AI, developer tools, and enterprise technology. You understand what makes them care about a product story, and you can get Lovable in front of them.
   

  

**You write clearly, concisely, and technically without being dry.** 
 Product comms doesn’t mean jargon-heavy. Your writing is precise, human, and accessible, even when the subject matter is complex or the situation is sensitive.
   

  

**You connect dots and see around corners.** 
 A feature ships, and you immediately think: which reporter is writing about this problem? What should our CTO say on social? How does this fit the narrative arc we’ve been building for the quarter? That connective instinct is what makes this role work.
   

  

**You’re hands-on, agile, and low-ego.** 
 You’ll draft the press materials, build the media list, coordinate the launch timeline, and prep the spokesperson. You thrive in environments where the plan changes and the pace is relentless.
   

  

**You have 8+ years of experience in communications** 
 , including product launches and trust or incident communications at a technology company. You’ve run launch processes, managed incident response, and built media relationships in the tech ecosystem.
   

  

 What you need to know
   

  

 This role requires genuine product immersion. You’ll work closely with product marketing to understand what’s shipping, why it matters, and how to position it. That partnership is what lets you move fast and tell the right story at the right moment.
   

  

 Trust and incident comms are core to the role. You’ll need to be comfortable being the person who’s on call when something breaks, who can draft an incident communication at speed, and who brings the judgment to know when to say something, when to wait, and how to say it right.
   

  

 Lovable is headquartered in Stockholm, with product and engineering teams across multiple offices. Wherever you sit, you’ll need to work effectively across time zones and build relationships with the teams who ship the product you’re talking about.
   

  

 Finally: joining Lovable Comms means you’re deeply curious, data-driven, and not extremely precious about role boundaries. You find ways to work smarter with AI, to measure what matters, and to step into work that isn't technically “yours” when the moment calls for it.
   

  

**Please Note:**
 This role is based out of either our Stockholm or London office, both of which have in-office requirements. This role is not eligible for remote work. We are unable to support work authorization in the UK at this time.
   

  

**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally — if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Security Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision.  2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$200M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

**The Role**
 At Legora, security is the foundation of the trust our customers place in us. The world’s leading law firms, as well as some of the biggest corporations use our platform for their most sensitive matters, and we need security to be built into how we design, ship, operate, and scale.
   

  

 We are looking for exceptional Security Engineers who can build leverage across a large surface area: a multi-tenant AI platform, a multi-cloud estate with Azure as our primary cloud, and an engineering organisation that ships fast. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will own security work end to end, build tooling and guardrails, embed with engineering teams, and make the secure path the default path.
   

  

 We hire T-shaped security engineers. You should bring real depth in one of Application Security, Detection Engineering & Response, or Cloud & Platform Security, while staying credible across the others. Tell us in your application which area is your specialisation.
   

  

*This role can be based in Stockholm or New York. It is a 5-day in-office role, we believe building together in person drives better outcomes.*
**What You Will Be Doing**
* Own security work end to end: architecture, tooling, roadmap, and outcomes.
* Work embedded with engineering teams to make secure design, development, and operations the default.
* Build and ship software: guardrails, detections, libraries, automation, and workflows that live in git, are reviewed, tested, and deployed through CI/CD.
* Raise the security bar across engineering through design reviews, threat modelling, tooling, and enablement.
* Fix the class of bug, not just the instance, by turning findings into patterns, defaults, or detections.
* Secure a multi-tenant AI platform, including identity, authorisation, tenant isolation, data handling, and model-facing attack surfaces.
* Build with LLMs and agents, and help secure code and workflows produced at agent speed.
* Respond to incidents and write post-mortems that lead to meaningful technical and organisational improvements.


**Your Specialisation**
* Application Security: Threat model features and architectures, review high-risk changes across authentication, authorisation, tenant isolation, and data handling, and secure AI and agentic product features against prompt injection, tool-use abuse, data exfiltration, and related attack paths.
* Detection Engineering & Response: Own detection-as-code, security data pipelines, abuse and account-compromise detection, and incident response across corporate and product surfaces. Build the agents that run first-pass triage and investigation, plus the guardrails and evals that make their output trustworthy. No tiered queue.
* Cloud & Platform Security: Harden identity, access, cloud control planes, CI/CD, supply chain, infrastructure-as-code, AKS baselines, tenant isolation primitives, and least-privilege access for engineers, workloads, and AI agents.


**Who You Are**
* Several years of engineering experience in your security specialisation, with real depth in vulnerabilities you have found, incidents you have run, systems you have hardened, or tooling you have built.
* You are an engineer who writes production-quality code; we work primarily in TypeScript/Node.js and Python.
* You are comfortable operating across application security, detection and response, and cloud/platform security, even if one of those areas is your main depth.
* You understand identity, authorisation, multi-tenancy, and where security boundaries tend to break.
* You communicate clearly, translate risk into engineering terms, and influence teams without relying on mandates.
* You are calm and structured under incident pressure, and honest afterwards.
* You are excited by a small team with a large surface area, where the right answer is usually to build leverage rather than create queues.


**Nice To Have**
* Experience securing LLM-based or agentic products.
* Experience building a security function at a high-growth SaaS company.
* Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS isolation models.
* Experience in environments with strict confidentiality, data residency, or professional secrecy requirements.
* Supply chain security depth, such as SLSA, artifact signing, or SBOMs.


 If you are close but not a perfect match on the list, apply anyway and tell us what you would own.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

description:
**Who are Benifex?** 
 💚💜
   

  

 We are a fast-moving technology company, and one of the most successful providers of online reward and benefits solutions in the world. We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build workplace technology that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to build remarkable experiences that employees love. Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. To help us on our quest to be the best, we need brilliant people on board and that’s where you come in. 🚀
   

  

**Why should you apply? 🌟**
* Take ownership of a high-impact leadership role where you will shape the future of Enterprise and Mid Market sales across the Nordics and play a key role in Benifex's next phase of growth.
* Join at an exciting transformation stage, helping to modernise sales processes, build scalable frameworks, and drive a more data-driven and predictable sales organisation.
* Lead and develop an established team while creating the structures, coaching culture and operational excellence.
* Partner closely with senior leadership to influence go-to-market strategy, sales methodology, account-based marketing initiatives and international expansion.
* Enjoy a role with significant visibility, autonomy and the opportunity to make a lasting impact on both culture and commercial results.
* Work for a profitable, fast-growing market leader in the online reward and employee benefits space.


**Great Benefits**
 🧠 ITP1 pension.
   

  

 ❤️ Lifeplan - a leading financial advisory service that offers personalized advice for maximizing your pension savings.
   

  

 📝 Collective agreement.
   

  

 💸 Access to our comprehensive benefits portal.
   

  

 🤸 Generous wellness allowance.
   

  

 ✈️ 30 vacation days / year.
   

  

 💰 Referral bonuses.
   

  

 🌟 Enhanced parental pay.
   

  

 🙂 Volunteer Days – two paid days annually to give back to the community.
   

  

**Role Overview 🚀**
 As Head of Sales, Nordic, you will lead our Nordic sales organisation, driving revenue growth, forecasting accuracy, sales execution and team performance across strategic accounts. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep Enterprise SaaS sales expertise with the ability to build a high-performing, supportive culture. You will lead a team of approximately eight sales professionals, the majority of whom are based in Stockholm, with a smaller number of team members located in Copenhagen. Working closely with senior leadership, you will implement modern sales methodologies, strengthen operational excellence and elevate the capabilities of an experienced sales team. Success in this role will come from your ability to coach, implement change, drive accountability and create structure while remaining approachable, pragmatic and collaborative. This is an office-first role, with an expectation of being in our Stockholm office at least four days per week.
   

  

**Responsibilities 🤘**
* Lead, coach and develop a team of Enterprise, Public Sector, Mid Market and SME Account Executives.
* Drive predictable new business revenue growth through strong pipeline management, forecasting discipline and sales execution.
* Play a key role in implementing and embedding a consistent sales methodology and qualification framework, with MEDDICC as a core operating model.
* Build a disciplined, data-driven sales culture focused on quality pipeline creation, deal progression and forecast accuracy.
* Lead and coach teams through complex, multi-stakeholder Enterprise opportunities and long sales cycles.
* Partner closely with Marketing, BDRs and Customer Success to improve pipeline generation and sales effectiveness.
* Leverage AI tools and modern sales technology to enhance coaching, forecasting, deal inspection and operational efficiency.
* Champion continuous learning, capability development and professional growth across the team.
* Foster a culture built on accountability, trust, humility and high performance.


**What are we looking for? 🔎**
* A minimum of 5 years' experience in Enterprise SaaS sales leadership.
* Strong track record working with complex Enterprise sales cycles, strategic accounts and multi-stakeholder buying groups.
* Deep understanding of Enterprise sales methodologies, with practical experience applying and embedding frameworks such as MEDDICC.
* Strong forecasting, pipeline management and CRM discipline, with a highly data-driven approach to decision making.
* Experience using modern sales technology and AI tools to improve productivity and team performance.
* Strong capability in coaching and developing sales professionals through complex opportunities and long sales cycles.
* A leadership style built on humility, trust, accountability and emotional intelligence.
* Strong commercial understanding of SaaS business models and recurring revenue environments.
* Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken. Candidates do not need to be fluent in Swedish. However, you should be comfortable understanding spoken and written Swedish in a business environment and collaborating effectively with Swedish-speaking colleagues and stakeholders.


**Bonus Points For**
* Experience selling into or leading teams focused on public sector opportunities, tenders, RFPs or procurement-led sales processes.
* Experience working closely with Marketing on account-based marketing initiatives and strategic outbound programmes.
* Experience supporting international expansion or leading sales teams across multiple markets.


 We want to make the application process as simple and fair as possible. That’s why we don’t ask for a cover letter for this role. Instead, you’ll find a few short questions in the application form. Your answers will help us understand your experience and skills in a more direct and relevant way.
   

  

 Apply today!

Our flagship early career rotational program spans 13 countries, including Brazil, Canada, China, India, Italy, Japan, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Poland, Sweden, Switzerland, United Kingdom, United States, and Vietnam. As a participant, you'll join an expanding global network, gaining exposure to diverse roles and experiences across various Business Units and Functions at Hitachi Energy.

Each rotation focuses on projects that enhance your skillset, allowing you to choose your assignment area. You'll join us as a full-time employee, steering your own career path from day one.
